guide.title: How to Use
guide.sellerStep1Desc: Explore trending spaces and popular venues. Filter by region, category, and size.
guide.sellerStep2Desc: Search the host directory to find providers and review their profiles and spaces.
guide.sellerStep3Desc: Submit an entry application. Once the host approves, your placement is confirmed.
guide.sellerStep4Desc: Review distribution proposals from vendors. Accept or decline offers.
guide.sellerStep5Desc: Track and manage product shipping status in real-time after placement confirmation.
guide.sellerStep6Desc: Check detailed sales and settlement records on the settlement page.
guide.sellerStep7Desc: Analyze your performance by period and space using CRM and statistics pages.
guide.sellerStep8Desc: Exchange information with other sellers and share trends in the seller community.
guide.sellerTip1: Complete your profile 100% to increase host approval rates.
guide.sellerTip2: Popular spaces fill up fast — enable notifications.
guide.sellerTip3: Active community participation creates more networking opportunities.
guide.hostStep1Desc: Register your popup/entry spaces with photos, location, pricing, and recruitment periods.
guide.hostStep2Desc: Review seller applications and approve or reject them. View seller profiles.
guide.hostStep3Desc: Browse seller categories, product photos, and activity history. Send distribution proposals.
guide.hostStep4Desc: Manage recruitment status per space. Set periods and maximum capacity.
guide.hostStep5Desc: Record sales data per space and track seller performance with CRM features.
guide.hostStep6Desc: Optimize space operations with detailed analytics reports and trend insights.
guide.hostStep7Desc: Maximize space exposure using marketing tools.
guide.hostStep8Desc: Share operational know-how and expand your seller network in the host community.
guide.hostTip1: High-quality photos significantly increase seller application rates.
guide.hostTip3: Regularly check analytics reports to optimize revenue.
guide.vendorStep1Desc: Browse seller categories, regions, and activity to find distribution partners.
guide.vendorStep2Desc: Create and send distribution proposals to sellers. Track acceptance status.
guide.vendorStep3Desc: Manage and track shipping status of approved deals in real-time.
guide.vendorStep4Desc: Review settlement records and manage pending amounts and schedules.
guide.vendorStep5Desc: Chat with sellers in real-time to coordinate deal details.
guide.vendorStep6Desc: Complete your company profile to build trust with sellers.
guide.vendorStep7Desc: Set up notifications for proposal results, shipping changes, etc.
guide.vendorStep8Desc: Contact administrators directly via chat for any inquiries.
guide.vendorTip1: A complete profile increases proposal acceptance rates.
guide.vendorTip2: Send proposals to diverse sellers to expand your network.
guide.vendorTip3: Real-time shipping updates improve seller satisfaction.
guide.adminStep1Desc: Monitor overall platform status — new signups, revenue, active users, and key metrics.
guide.adminStep2Desc: Manage seller, host, and vendor accounts. Change roles, approve, or block users.
guide.adminStep3Desc: Edit space information and manage recruitment status.
guide.adminStep4Desc: Process entry applications and cancellation requests.
guide.adminStep5Desc: Review payment status and manage settlements.
guide.adminStep6Desc: Run ads, email marketing, promotions, and popups.
guide.adminStep7Desc: Manage security, menu visibility, and popup settings.
guide.adminStep8Desc: Monitor community boards and manage inappropriate content.
guide.adminTip1: Check the dashboard daily to detect platform issues early.
guide.adminTip3: Use email marketing to boost user engagement.
